question: Will NVIDIA (NVDA) close higher on Aug 27, 2026 than its Aug 26, 2026 close after its Q2 FY2027 earnings release?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if NVDA's official NASDAQ regular-session closing price on Aug 27, 2026 is strictly greater than its official NASDAQ regular-session closing price on Aug 26, 2026.
- "No": Wins if NVDA's official NASDAQ regular-session closing price on Aug 27, 2026 is less than or equal to its official NASDAQ regular-session closing price on Aug 26, 2026.

Clarifications:
- "Closing price" refers to the unadjusted official closing price of NVIDIA Corporation (ticker: NVDA) on the NASDAQ exchange at the end of each day's regular trading session (4:00 PM ET), not any after-hours or pre-market price.
